text:
Morgan (Finance Ops): Heads-up: LumiCore Labs is asking for a 12-month committed plan with a monthly overage hard-cap, an upfront onboarding credit, and Net45. They need pricing appendix in contract by Thursday. Can we triage?
Eli (AE): Customer signed LOI; procurement insists on Net45 and wants an overage cap of $10k/mo to avoid runaway invoices. Also asking for a $7,500 onboarding credit to offset integration costs.
Morgan (Finance Ops): Initial economics: proposed commit $120,000/yr, list unit $0.0007/token. They want tiered effective price ~35% below list after credits.
Reema (RevOps): Questions: can BillRun handle a hard cap vs invoice credit? Need to avoid manual credits each month. Also check recognition impact for ARR.
Tomas (Legal): Hard caps are risky. Suggest conditional cap: cap applies only if customer reaches >=85% of monthly committed usage for preceding 2 months and no anomalous traffic. Also add audit and anti-fraud language.
Eli (AE): Procurement wants a hard cap written plainly. Conditional cap may be acceptable if we keep the cap for first 4 months guaranteed.
Priya (CFO): I don't want wholesale margin erosion. Share the final model. Threshold: gross margin must remain >=58% after credits. If not, need exec approval.
Morgan (Finance Ops): Draft proposal: \n```\nCommit: $120,000/yr (12 months)\nUnit tiers: 0-1M tokens @ $0.00045/token\n>1M tokens @ $0.00040/token\nOverage cap: $10,000/month (months 1-4 guaranteed), months 5-12 cap $5,000 conditional on usage >=85% for months 3-4\nOnboarding credit: $7,500 applied to first invoice\nPayment terms: Net45\nAuto-renew: no\n```\nReema (RevOps): Implementation note: we'll implement cap as automated invoice credit up to cap amount. I'll open BR ticket and include logic for gating on consumption metrics and fraud flags.
Tomas (Legal): I'll draft an appendix with the staged cap + usage gate + audit rights + clawback for misuse. Recommend limiting cap to non-bot traffic.
Eli (AE): Customer deadline Thursday EOD. Can we get CFO sign-off today? Procurement is on a vendor evaluation cycle.
deal-bot: Deal updated: LumiCore Labs 1-2026 026-078 026-078-special-pricing queued. (link: https://sales.internal/opps/2026-078) :pushpin:
Morgan (Finance Ops): Quick sensitivity: at forecasted usage (1.2M tokens/mo) the monthly overage without cap ~ $12k; with guarantees it's $10k for first 4 months then variable. Effective discount vs list ~34%.
Priya (CFO): Approve in principle with conditions: 1) margin floor >=58% confirmed by Finance, 2) Legal appendix includes usage gate and clawback, 3) RevOps deploys automated alerts if variance >20% vs forecast. If all met, I sign off.
Eli (AE): Thanks Priya 60; I'll get the final P&L to Morgan now and loop Legal.
Reema (RevOps): Ticket created #BR-9877, priority high. ETA 3 business days to deploy invoice credit automation and gating.
Tomas (Legal): Drafted appendix and sent to Eli for quick review. Will route for signature via Docusign when AE confirms.
Morgan (Finance Ops): I'll upload the special pricing memo to the deal record and mark as 'approved-exception' once P&L is attached.
Eli (AE): Procurement informed, they schedule the vendor approval call tomorrow. Thanks everyone.
Morgan (Finance Ops): Closing this thread 10. Final steps: attach P&L, Legal appendix, BR ticket link to the opportunity, and mark registry entry as non-standard. :white_check_mark:
